reviews.title: Best Running app!
reviews.text: I’ve used a lot of different running apps and as a new runner or a runner returning back to Running after about 10 years, this is the best app to ease you into running without feeling defeated

reviews.title: Loving it!
reviews.text: I really do love this app on both my phone & watch; super easy to use, no glitches, my data right there with variety of options, very user-friendly.  Thank you!

reviews.title: Helped me fulfill my dream
reviews.text: As a complete non-runner I never believed i could even run 1k regularly and now, At 46 Starting with the app 3 months ago i now manage running 3.5km 3 times a week.

reviews.title: Finally an app for true beginners
reviews.text: I love this app! I’ve tried many running apps and even the ones made for beginners progress too quickly for most people. Going from no running to 20-30 minutes of consecutive running in just 4-9 weeks is just not realistic for a lot of people, and that’s the time frame that other apps give you. From 0 to 20 minutes in 4 weeks, or 0 to 25 minutes in 9 weeks is fast. From 0 to 25 minutes in 12 weeks with None to Run is doable. Especially as someone prone to injuries, taking it slow enough to avoid injury but still stay motivated and see progress is so important. The strength trainings included with each week are so helpful as well to build those running muscles. And for people that are already running, you can train for a 5k or a 10k using this app. It’s not just for beginners.

reviews.title: This got me running after 20 years
reviews.text: I hate running. I haven’t run since 2005. At 43, I’m more aware of my cardiovascular health declining. Running felt both boring and intimidating; I didn’t know where to start. 2 weeks in and I can see myself doing this forever. Thank you!!

reviews.title: FINALLY A RUNNING APP THAT WORKS!!!
reviews.text: I have tried so many running apps over the years.  So many have really fancy features and routes and gamification and such.  However, none did two things right that I wanted - start the workout on the phone, have a mirror on the Apple Watch to see stats during the run, and don’t impact the music.  This one is what I’ve been looking for!!!!  Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Breakthrough!
reviews.text: I gave up on running 20 years ago because I always ended up being seriously injured. It was very frustrating because when I did it I loved it but now this app has to help me to have a big breakthrough. I managed to do the whole 12-week program without a hitch and I can call myself a runner now. I'm deeply grateful for this app

reviews.title: TRUST THE PROCESS! This is IT!
reviews.text:
Mark knows what he's talking about.
After multiple injuries over several years and programs, I'm finally succeeding. And RUNNING! I needed to check my ego at the door and agree with myself to actually follow the program. Were the first two weeks insanely easy and I was almost embarrassed to call it running? Yep, but I loved the schedule, I loved the strength training that was doable physically AND time-wise. And guess what? By week three I felt my muscles muscleing. I WAS getting stronger. At week 10 I was scared for the "jump," (and Mark DOES have a bridge for that if it's too scary), but I kept reading the encouraging words in the app and decided to go for it. The keys are all about consistency and going SLOW (I know, trust me, I know!!) to build your BASE. That was what I never fully developed before. I really love running now, because I'm not scared I'm going to get hurt again (sure, a twisted ankle can happen to anyone, but you know what I mean). This program doesn't hurt, IF you listen to Mark. Between the app, the email newsletter,  and the FB group, you really never feel alone. He actually encourages you to respond, and--wait for it--REPLIES back to you!! He actually cares about helping people get healthy and fall in love with running. The app definitely makes the experience more fun, enjoyable, and consistent, but he's even put the plans up for free as print outs because he cares that much. He believes in running, and he believes anyone can be a runner, and with this program, I do too! I encourage you to give this journey to yourself as a gift. After you're done with the starting program(s) (there are ones that will even help you start if 30 minutes of walking is difficult right now), there are programs for 5k, 10k, and half marathon!

reviews.title: Awesome Plan It Works
reviews.text: Great plan, great support, education and program options.

reviews.title: Best Beginning Run App!
reviews.text:
I am not a runner and this app is turning me into one!  It’s hard to run but the way this program eases you into it has made this achievable!  I’m 57 and I’m on week 5, run 2 and it’s getting easier and easier.  Hard to believe it’s getting easier but it makes sense when you are eased into a program and not jumping right in to running and suffering from injuries.  I have bad knees and this program works great for me and my knees!
Thank you None 2 Run Team!!!!

reviews.title: Great app and program
reviews.text: Really enjoying running with the app. Program is wonderfully embedded in the app. Well worth the money.

reviews.title: This app got me places I never thought I could reach
reviews.text: This app has been an amazing experience honestly. I have a MCL tear in each knee. Right one is smaller than the left. The left hurts pretty much most of the time walking, playing pickleball. Also whenever I would swim my left knee would hurt just doing the kicking motion. With all that said I gave your app a shot to build around my knee aswell as conditioning. This morning I completed my first ever 25 minute run. I am shocked I have gotten this far. I have gone on trips during this time and I swim full speed with no pain in my left knee. Now it still smarts while playing pickleball but that’s cutting and stopping quickly. I have been impressed at my body and appreciate this app in getting me to this point. I also believed in you when I made that jump to 20 mins. You said I could do it. And I did! Thank you and your team.

reviews.title: Completely awesome perfect for new runners
reviews.text: This is a must try app for new runners it helped me so much with running.

reviews.title: Only time I’ve rated an app
reviews.text: I’m trying to figure out how to be honest without sounding like a sponsored ad. I’ve never ran in my life, actually I didn’t LIKE running at all. I decided to start and I knew I’d need some type of guidance. This was more than I was ever bargaining for. It has all the features I didn’t even know I needed. The fact it verbally speaks the directions to you is the one that got me hooked because what?? It does such a good job fostering a sense of pride and achievement, like I just got my first week achievement and I’m bragging to everyone I know. 10/10, I tried 2 or 3 other apps briefly and they didn’t compare at all.

reviews.title: I LOVE this app
reviews.text: I have wanted to run for a long time, but I was overweight and way out of shape. I took a leap of faith and tried None to Run and I am so so glad I did! The intervals are small and build gradually, plus the easy strength workouts are amazing as well. I remember when running 30 seconds felt like a lifetime and now I can run 3 miles without stopping. This app allowed me to become a runner and fall in love with the sport. Thank you None to Run!!

reviews.title: Best running app I’ve ever used
reviews.text: I have done several 5K running programs over the years, and I always had to take time off due to injuries. Currently I’m 8 weeks in without any breaks due to injuries. I’m also closer than I ever have been to running 5K without having to take tons of walk breaks. It’s a wonderful program, and I thank Coach Mark for it!

reviews.title: From none to 5ks at 50ish.
reviews.text: So excited to find this program. I’m in my 50’s thought my health didn’t allow me to run. But N2R taught me I could take my time build up at my pace, in my time. And now I’m well on my way of not only running 5ks regularly but dropping my time. I’m so grateful for this program.

reviews.title: The best for TRUE beginners
reviews.text: I just completed the None to Run plan and loved how truly beginner-friendly it was! The ramp up is slower than other plans targeted at beginners and for that reason it actually is do-able for just about anyone. I’m now onto the 5k race plan and am loving my running journey. My advice is: just get started! Even if it seems daunting, you will surprise yourself and feel great!

reviews.title: Great app for ALL levels
reviews.text:
Love this app. A friend told me about this as an alternative to Couch to 5K; I tried the N2R free trial and decided the annual subscription is worth every penny. It's like paying $3 a month for a professional-level coach in your pocket whenever you need. I like how it's relaxed ("Rest a day or two between workouts") rather than rigid (i.e. you MUST run on this M-W-F schedule) and is such a positive mix of flexibility within healthy structures. I couldn't run for 5m straight before starting this, but they literally have a "Run Ready" program to prepare you even at THAT level. The goal is to have a healthy relationship with running for your entire life, and they really understand the psychology behind that with how this whole app is designed. 

I like how every training has a PDF version if you just want a quick glance, and the videos are helpful for strengthening muscles throughout the week that help you run. You can also "run freely" or set custom intervals and still track it. I like how many links are shareable so I can inspire my mom and sister, too. There are blogs, a community, guidance, etc. so you literally have everything you need to make it work (for ANY personality). No excuses but yourself!!

My only "critique" is I actually liked when the British lady's voice was leading each run; she had a very soothing nature, which felt extra inviting for someone who was new to running. 

I did the N2R program to start and was shocked at how the incremental gains actually *WORKED* for preparing me to be a runner. They seemed so small and invisible! If you follow the program consistently, you will get exactly what they say.

reviews.title: Love love love
reviews.text: Easy to use but keeps you accountable to your goal. Very encouraging in each plan.

reviews.title: N2R Improved My Health
reviews.text:
I just wanted to share that I was the kid in gym class who was always picked last. I was an honors student who somehow managed to get a D in gym because I truly disliked sports, especially running! Last year, at age 57, I had a health scare that made me realize I needed to completely overhaul my health. I had actually tried None 2 Run during COVID and quit around week four, so I was not sure I would succeed this time.

But this time I stuck with it, and I still cannot believe that I completed all 12 weeks. I am now in better shape than I have ever been in my life, and several of my health issues have reversed. None 2 Run truly helped me change the trajectory of my health.

reviews.title: Still not a runner
reviews.text: The program is still too fast and I can’t get past week four. I’ve tried several times and pretty much have had enough.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: If you’re new to running this is a great app to use. It has a beginner plan that gets you running at your pace over about 12 wks and at the end you can run 20m straight. Then a 5K, 10k or 1/2 marathon plans. It makes it easy for anyone to start from wherever they are. None of the workouts have a speed limit so it doesn’t matter, and it challenges you. You might think you can’t do the new weeks workout but if you just slow down a bit you find that it is doable

reviews.title: Great app for getting started
reviews.text: Love this app and has helped me stay on track! I’ve started a running program 2 other times and it was too aggressive. This is a perfect app for starting out and building up to longer runs! Very easy to use - HIGHLY recommend!

reviews.title: This app made all the difference!
reviews.text: I chose N2R after reading other reviews. I was skeptical that I would ever consider myself a runner or could achieve my running goals. However, the app and training plans have made it possible. I just follow the plan and the app talks me through that day’s schedule as I go. If you’re on the fence, give it a try. You have nothing to lose 👍🏻

reviews.title: Way Better Than Couch to 5K
reviews.text: This programming is so much better than Couch-to-5K. The increase in distance is much, much more gradual. It was easier to be consistent. Cheers to PRs in the new year! 💪

reviews.title: Running Made Easy
reviews.text: I am a person who “hates” to run but always envy the people who make it look easy . This AP made it possible to go from running a block to longer distances by learning to pace myself and take small bites at a time .

reviews.title: Awesome App!
reviews.text: I love this app because it helps me to feel confident that I can start small and do something great. I’m 48 and I’m afraid that I may hurt myself. The gradual increase of activity was perfect for me.  I worked with a physical therapist and now I feel confident about my ability to run again.  It was 13 years that I ran a half marathon.  Who knows, maybe I’ll do it again.  Plus, this so so much more cheaper than a monthly gym membership!

reviews.title: Run Ready, Beginner - now a 5k Runner!
reviews.text: I downloaded N2R in January 2025 when I hit a plateau with my health goals. I used the Run Ready plan to get started, which is designed for folks who have not really tried running before and leans into walk/run intervals. In February I started the Beginner Running Plan, which helps build up stamina through those intervals and strength training to get to continuous running over 12 weeks! I did NOT think it would be possible to ever get to running 20 minutes continuously - but was able to achieve that goal by May/June! I moved on to the 5k plan and even though I haven’t finished the training plan yet, I just ran in my first 5k race and performed better than I thought I would! But it’s not only the supportive training ramps; Mark and team have built an incredible community of people who (optionally) check in with each other along the way and remind each other we’ve all physically and mentally experienced what another has. Plus, N2R has a great blog archive to tap into when needing a mental push or to troubleshoot a run. I’ve used the blog posts and articles along the way to debunk myths and to learn a new way my body will respond to running. I’m now at a point where I’m looking to improve my pace and distances and have achieved health goals that I’m super proud of! I would recommend N2R for anyone looking to get into running or even get their body acclimated into a supportive running ramp after injury or time away!

reviews.title: Gently gets you running long distances
reviews.text: Slow-build, gentle program, perfect for those starting out or getting back in as an older adult.

reviews.title: Absolutely worth it
reviews.text: I am on the older side of middle age and have not run in YEARS. Even when I did “run” it was short, inefficient sessions. I’ve tried other apps in the past but abandoned them when I felt I wasn’t making progress or they became too overwhelming. I started N2R hesitantly, but was surprised early on about how doable it was. I repeated weeks when I needed, and my last workout of the program was a 5K!  (I did have to walk some, but now I know I can get there!) Definitely recommend, and I promise, if *I* can do it, anyone can!

reviews.title: A must have for all runners
reviews.text: This program is like no other, the amount of support is amazing! For the beginner it tapers up at a pace that even the most out of shape person can follow. I started this program a few years ago when I could hardly walk a mile.

reviews.title: The perfect extra motivation!
reviews.text: I’m a 59-year-old female, in good health, but not as active as I should be. I’m just about halfway through and this has been a great discipline and a great pace! I’ve tried running before, and I’ve had knee pain very early on, but none thus far. Would recommend this for anyone who is trying to get more active without killing themselves!

reviews.title: Way More Realistic Goal Setting Than Other Apps!!!
reviews.text: After the pandemic hit, I became seriously sedentary for the past 5 years, gaining over 50 pounds. (Ouch!) I used to run, so I know my body. Too many times I have started to try to run again, only to get an injury pretty shortly into the training. I looked for an app where I could customize my intervals even smaller than 30 seconds jogging. THIS IS THE ONLY ONE!!!! THANK YOOOOU!!! Our bodies are all different and we are in different stages. This makes me feel SO much more motivated!

reviews.title: Just what I wanted!
reviews.text: Being a 62 year-old woman and overweight, I wanted to up my cardio exercise to improve my health. I have never been a runner and wanted to start slowly. I looked into the Couch to Run program but thought it moved too quickly in only 8 weeks. I discovered the N2R app and committed to the 12 week program. I wanted to be prompted in my ear wearing earphones so I didn’t have to keep checking my phone. It was the perfect program for me! By eating more healthy and implementing this program, I lost 25 lbs in those 12 weeks and feel so much better. I would truly recommend this program.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I’ve tried many apps but they all seem a little too advanced for me at 63 yrs old. I felt accomplished today because it was a plan I could follow as is. It felt good.

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: I am on week 6 of my journey with None to Run and I highly recommend it! I am running for the first time in my life. Not only has the plan been easy to follow I lost love the little touches like the 5 second reminders when starting and ending a run/walk interval.

reviews.title: Amazing App!
reviews.text: I hated running but always wanted to love it….. thanks to this super easy program I’ve gradually fell in love and increased my stamina tremendously and I’m only on week 8! Much better than couch to 5K and well worth the money!

reviews.title: Makes running achievable!
reviews.text: Very easy to use and really breaks down the way to properly build up endurance in a safe beginner environment. You have to put in the work but it’s attainable and achievable!

reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: I love it. I’ve never really been a runner. Played basketball when I was younger so we’d sprint at practice but that was it. I ended up being obese after kids so after losing the weight, wanted to find something I could do that didn’t require much to begin. Long story short, love this app, the support, the plan - it’s worth every penny. Absolutely recommend. I love running now (starting week 8 of 12 for the None to Run plan). Hate my “off” days. I keep trying to get my friends involved by enticing them with a free month but think you’re only here if you have the desire to run. If that’s why you’re here, this is the app/plan.

reviews.title: Starting in my 60’s!
reviews.text: At 62 and never before running in my life, I started the beginner plan. I repeated a few weeks but I finished today - next up 5k plan!  I am so grateful!  Highly recommend the app. Stick with it!  It works!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This app is amazing. I just finished the Beginner challenge and am running 25 minutes straight. I hated running before this and could barely run 45 seconds at a time. I had to repeat weeks multiple times but Mark makes you feel encouraged by this instead of discouraged. I highly recommend this app for those that have never run before. It’s an attainable plan that works!
